subject: Request for extraordinary Hosted API rate relief — Orthomed
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Orthomed — request for >20% Hosted API reduction (info + ask)

Ben / Marissa —

Quick summary: Orthomed (Series B med-dev, large extracted-text ingestion for clinical notes) is asking for a 25% reduction on Hosted API usage rates as part of a 12-month commit. They flagged a competitive renewal window and made the case that lowering unit cost keeps us in the procurement short-list.

Why this matters:
- They project 75M tokens/month and want pricing certainty for 12 months.
- They are sensitive to TCO vs. self-hosting; our Hosted API is the fastest path to value.
- If we lose them, they’ve indicated they would evaluate two competitors and an on-prem alternative.

Commercial proposal we’ve built with the customer:
- 12-month committed spend (~$350k/month expected run-rate)
- Request: 25% discount off list Hosted API per-token rates (this is >20% and outside standard approval).
- We’d include a 90-day technical onboarding SLA and quarterly QBRs.

Attachments: usage report (Jul 2026) and our proposed MMAP with redlines.

Marissa — can you confirm margin impact and whether we should add any conditionals (e.g., minimum monthly commitment, early termination recoup)?
Ben — recommend we propose approval to Rishi with clear escalation case (strategic account, whitepaper co-marketing ask, reference potential).

Customer contact: Lydia Park (CFO) — copied below in subsequent thread for transparency. I held off copying external for this internal ask.

Thanks,
Ava
Ava Chen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orthomed — request for >20% Hosted API reduction (info + ask)

Thanks Ava — looked through the numbers and attached a quick P&L sensitivity in the redline doc. Short take:

- 25% flat discount on Hosted API usage without conditionals would drop gross margin below our target for a standard Hosted SKU given the modeled 75M tokens/mo.
- With a binding 12-month commit and a minimum monthly commitment (we proposed $300k/mo), margin is acceptable for an initial ramp.
- Recommend approval with conditions: 12-month contract, minimum monthly spend clause, and a one-time onboarding fee to cover integration support if legal accepts it.

If we add a clause that allows us to step the discount down after 6 months if actual usage is 30% below forecast, that's safer than blanket 25%.

I can draft the conditional language for legal. From a deal-desk perspective this is reasonable if leadership signs off on strategic value (ref, market visibility).

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Deal Desk, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Orthomed — request for >20% Hosted API reduction (internal ask + recommendation)

Rishi — forwarding the summary and Marissa's recommendation. Short note: Orthomed is considered strategically valuable (healthcare vertical reference + potential pipeline introductions to three hospital systems). They have tight procurement timelines and are asking for a 25% Hosted API unit reduction.

Why I’m asking for exec exception:
- Competitive risk: procurement says they’ll move to self-host or another provider unless we offer meaningful runtime economics.
- Lifetime value looks strong if we keep them as a hosted customer (expansion to embeddings + reranking likely).
- We can require a minimum commitment and safeguard clauses that Marissa proposes.

Proposed ask: Executive approval to grant up to 25% discount on Hosted API rates for a 12-month term subject to: minimum $300k/month commitment, conditional step-down if usage undershoots, and a $25k onboarding fee.

If you approve, Marissa will finalize contract redlines and legal will fast-track.

Ben
VP of Sales | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Orthomed — request for >20% Hosted API reduction (internal ask + recommendation)

Team — after reviewing the context and Marissa's margin mitigations I approve an exception to allow up to a 25% discount on Hosted API usage for Orthomed under the following firm conditions: 

1) Signed 12-month commitment for a minimum of $300k/mo (recoup if early termination).
2) Discount is applied to baseline monthly usage up to the committed volume; overages billed at standard list rates unless we separately agree to extend.
3) Include a 6-month usage review clause with the ability to adjust discount if actual usage is <70% of forecast.
4) One-time $25k onboarding fee to cover hands-on integration and QBR tooling.
5) Legal to include standard audit right and a clause preventing resale/transfers.

Ben/Ava — proceed to get signatures. Marissa — work with Legal to bake these terms into the MMAP redline; I expect an exec summary for finance prior to E-sign.

Rishi
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com
